GOAL 160: the bare `[data-message-content]` fallback was REMOVED from `answer` — it matched any node carrying that attribute anywhere on the page, so a status region could win the longest-element read and be served as the answer (MEASURED 2026-09-30: HTTP 200 with `Cooking…`). The answer selector is now scoped to the assistant message row. `capability.nonAnswerSelectors` names the status/thinking regions as a site-declared signal; that list is DERIVED-NOT-LIVE-VERIFIED and is pinned hermetically (test/readback-freshness.test.ts) so it cannot be silently widened back. note163: GOAL 163 (2026-09-30) — THE GOAL-160 FIX DID NOT HOLD FOR v0, and the cause was found. Re-measured on the deployed build 73fc38e: HTTP 200 in 13543ms at an idle pool (busy 0, total 3, queued 0) carrying 'Exploring ideas...'. That is outcome (c) — the gate has a hole — and it is reported as such rather than papered over. DIAGNOSIS, from v0's OWN shipped JS bundle (69 chunks fetched unauthenticated from v0.app; zero requests to the account), not from a widened selector: (1) `data-message-content` is NOT exclusive to the answer. The bundle renders it on the assistant content wrapper (`"assistant"===n ? jsx(F.f,{className:"w-full","data-message-content":!0, ...})`) AND uses the same attribute inside the agent-activity region — the live class string is `[&_[data-agent-activity-entry]_[data-message-content]>p:first-child]`, i.e. the site's own code addresses `[data-agent-activity-entry] [data-message-content]` as a thing that exists. (2) The 'Exploring' placeholder is exactly that region: the activity renderer passes `textActive:"Exploring", textComplete:"Explored"` into a component tree that also emits `data-agent-activity-entry` and `data-task-timeline` markers, and the activity container is classed `group/rich-task`. (3) Therefore the GOAL-160 answer selector, though correctly scoped to the assistant ROW, is still a DESCENDANT selector and matches the activity entry's `data-message-content` too; the readback takes the longest match, so the activity placeholder wins and is served. (4) And the declared nonAnswerSelectors could not catch it: two of the three match nothing on v0, and the third, `[data-state="streaming"]:not([data-message-content])`, explicitly EXCLUDES `[data-message-content]` — i.e. by construction it could never match the one element at fault. The GOAL-160 gate only refuses when a DECLARED non-answer region was seen; nothing was declared for the region that actually produced the wrong string, so the read settled 'stable' and served it. THE FIX declares v0's own activity/timeline markers as non-answer, using the attribute names from the bundle rather than a class substring, so the readback drops them from the answer candidate set (readAnswerRegionFromPage skips every excluded element before the longest-match read) and the real answer is left standing; if nothing answer-shaped survives, the gate refuses with the named `non-answer`. The descendant forms are declared alongside the containers on purpose: the exclusion set holds the MATCHED element only, so excluding `[data-agent-activity-entry]` alone would NOT exclude the `data-message-content` inside it. NOT LIVE-VERIFIED: this diagnosis is bundle-derived. The live capture this goal attempted attached to a stale landing-page pool tab (`https://v0.app/`, zero message rows) instead of the driven `/chat` tab, and v0's request budget was spent, so no rendered snapshot of the activity entry was obtained. The bundle evidence for the attribute names is direct and unambiguous, but the fix is an unverified-candidate until a re-deploy plus a live round trip shows either the real PONG or a named non-answer refusal.
